Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment before I send a formal MAP:

Summary from our call:
- Goal: Run Redwood inference for Acme's customer support summarization pipeline (40-80 req/s, 512 tokens avg)
- Primary success criteria: <72ms p50 latency at 50 req/s + <=$0.08/1k tokens after batching optimizations; data never leaves Acme VPC during private deployment
- Critical dependency: SOC2 evidence & network peering (security team must approve by 2026-05-03)

I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf) with milestones, owners, and target close/go-live dates. Highlights:
- Milestone 1 (POC): config + small dataset test - 2026-05-10 - Owner: Acme Eng (Tom) / Redwood DevOps (Dev)
- Milestone 2 (Security review & peering): evidence & network tests - 2026-05-03 - Owner: Acme Security (S. Lee) / Redwood Security (Camila)
- Milestone 3 (Pilot & performance validation): SLA baseline - 2026-05-24 - Owner: Acme Eng / Redwood Infra
- Go-live target: 2026-06-01 (soft launch)

Please review the attached MAP and let me know if any dates/owners need adjusting. If everything looks good, confirm and we'll produce a final SOW and signature-ready documents.

Next steps I propose:
1) Samantha - confirm security review window and whether 2026-05-03 is achievable
2) Tom - confirm engineering availability for the POC week (w/c 2026-05-04)
3) We'll circulate a final MAP + SOW for signature once dependencies are confirmed

Thanks -
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0114
